app_concept: Hues turns pitches and chords into color: every note has one fixed color and a chord is a gradient from its lowest to its highest note.
primary_metaphor: Three tall tiles in a charcoal shell, each a bottom-to-top gradient through the pitch colors of one chord (Am, F, C)
supporting_motifs: raised rounded tiles with a soft top highlight
gradients that share colors across neighboring chords
palette_hints: pitch colors: orange A, green C, purple E, violet F, red G
